items.text: In this team, I can admit a mistake without fear of embarrassment.
In this team, I can ask for help without being judged as incompetent.
In this team, I can express uncertainty without losing others' respect.
In this team, I can question a decision without being treated badly.
In this team, people who acknowledge mistakes are made to feel ashamed.
In this team, expressing a different opinion can lead to rejection by others.
In this team, raising a concern puts a person's standing with teammates at risk.
